polymer sampling. The new source-specific input is a local, unique-history
presentation of EXACT admissible RX/RZ syndromes. KP convergence alone is
not asserted to provide a sampler. No hardware or noisy-preparation result
is claimed, and world priority is UNKNOWN.

## 1. Target and theorem

Fix the PRIMARY-QUALIFIED odd subdivision ell, its accepted recursive family,
and its nominal commuting Hamiltonian H0,k=sum_j(I-S_j)/2. Let Sigma_k be
the actual admissible joint syndrome space, including all redundant-check
relations. The target is the classical law

    pi_beta(sigma)=exp(-beta|sigma|)/Z_syn, sigma in Sigma_k.   (1)

There is one sufficiently low FIXED temperature, beta=4ln B0, independent
of level k, at which the construction below samples (1) within TV error
epsilon in time polynomial in n_k and 1/epsilon, with explicit costs.
The constants depend on the actual fixed ell and source degree/cell bounds;
they may be enormous. Beta can also be chosen above the already specified
memory counting threshold. This supplies a polynomial ideal preparation
contract for the NOMINAL corrected thermal encoder. It does not sample the
full Gibbs state by physical time evolution.

The algorithm uses the public finite complexes and local rules. It is not
given a global generator, a microscopic state, a thermal sampler, or an
unpaid polymer-generation oracle. Global syndrome membership is used only
as an independent finite consumer check, not in the production predicates.

29 October 2026. This is an admitted/reconstructed ordinary polymer algorithm,
not a new sampling invention. Its family-specific computability premises are
paid by PROOF.md and literal_history.py. It improves the precision dependence
of the executed finite-list receiver; that slower receiver remains valid.

## 1. Controlling primary result

Chen--Galanis--Goldberg--Perkins--Stewart--Vigoda,
[1901.06653v6](https://arxiv.org/html/1901.06653), Definitions3--4,
Theorems2/5, and Sections2.2--2.3, requires computable allowed polymers and
exponential decay stronger than merely KP. For a binary model its sampling
condition is tau>=5+3ln Delta. Here tau=beta/4=ln B0. One fixed
B0>=Abar^4 satisfies this (Abar=4max(1,Delta_bar)); increase it further if
the primary memory temperature criterion requires it. The primary supplies
a stronger same-information algorithm and must not be hidden behind our
slower finite-list benchmark.

Theorem 5 states a bounded runtime guarantee in its algorithmic model. Our
literal fair-bit implementation below is admitted only with the independently
proved EXPECTED bit-work contract. We do not turn its expected update cost
into that stronger statement by restarting conditioned on finishing quickly.

Here is a completely specified rational expected-time version of its rooted
proposal, so no enumeration or real-coin oracle is free. We use fixed-count
Markov updates and do not condition the output on a favourable runtime.

## 2. Exact rooted proposal and finite input costs

Let A=4max(1,Delta), R=A², and choose root v. Draw an integer K with

    Pr(K>=s)=R^(-s), 1<=s<=N.

This is the number of consecutive successes of a rational 1/R coin, capped
at N. Capping retains all required tails since no polymer has size>N.

# Root review of polynomial nominal syndrome initialization

Root whole-read c_syndrome_initializer/PROOF.md and all318 lines of the literal
history predicates on29October2026. Root directly checked primary Theorems4.6
and4.7, Lemmas4.8 and4.12 in the cached2605.10943v1 source. ACCEPTED at the
all-level mathematical scope below; finite consumer arithmetic is separate.

The local primary fills apply to EVERY admissible syndrome, without a small-
weight premise. Deterministic bounded-cell search with zero at zero defines
local predicates. Successful RX factors exhibit an exact correction identity
and a chain-map lift of the coarse syndrome. RZ connected blocks have exactly
one remaining parity class; coarse preimages lift and residual even parities
fill locally. Together with the constant seed image test, this proves the
CONVERSE as well as forward admission, including redundant parity relations.
Auxiliary sampling maps need not be the memory recovery rule; the final
encoder still uses the same previously chosen corrected logical algebra.

Syndrome-only histories are unique, binary and zero-preserving. Every factor
sees nonzeros from at most one primal-graph connected component, so components
are separately accepted and compatible unions are accepted. No decoration
multiplicity appears. The primary alternating contraction gives history
weight<=4 times top weight. Bounded factor arity/fanout gives a uniform-degree
graph with O(n) variables. Thus the positive hard-core activities are exact
and decay at least as exp(-beta size/4).

Root independently supplied/reconstructed the size-weighted heat-bath coupling:
updating the discrepant polymer erases its weighted discrepancy, while potential
incompatible insertions add at most the rooted activity-size sum. With one
fixed sufficiently large B0 the contraction is uniform; it does not require
beta to grow with log n. Connected-set enumeration up to a paid logarithmic
cutoff and the omitted-weight union bound give polynomial time in n and1/epsilon.
At beta=4ln B0 all activities and update coins are rational; the finite integer-
rejection caps and failure output contribute the declared TV budget. This is
ordinary polymer/path-coupling machinery with a source-specific admission.
